title: Fix place-self/place-items collapsing non-equal values
author: hdimer
summary: PlaceSelf/PlaceItems ToCss drop the second value when they think the longhands are equal, but three arms compare wrongly (justify-self:auto always collapses; justify stretch compared against align normal). The minifier therefore silently changes justify-self/justify-items, a layout-changing output bug in common grid/flex CSS. Three-line fix with tests.
evidence: Master: `.a{align-self:self-start;justify-self:auto}` -> `.a{place-self:self-start}` (justify-self becomes self-start); `.b{align-items:normal;justify-items:stretch}` -> `.b{place-items:normal}`; `.c{align-self:normal;justify-self:stretch}` -> `.c{place-self:normal}`. Only PR for #1182; no reviews. Reviewer should also check PlaceContent and the legacy/left/right justify-items values for the same pattern.
